text.tspan: I used to handle this badly. We booked the
mid-morning flight and arrived as people, not
wreckage.
What changed is simpler than it sounds. Shared
a table with travelers who recommended a park
we would have skipped.
Plans are useful. Rigidity is not.
Writing it down so I do not forget.
Travel lighter so you can move freer.
We photographed less and talked more about
what we saw.
Attention is the real souvenir.
I packed one nicer outfit and felt ready for
the unexpected dinner.
Leave room for the unplanned good thing.
I packed one nicer outfit and felt ready for
the unexpected dinner.
Kindness from strangers is a travel skill you
can also practice.
We booked the mid-morning flight and arrived
as people, not wreckage.
The trip continues in how you return to
ordinary days.
We photographed less and talked more about
what we saw.
Write a little so memory has handles later.

a park we would have skipped.
Buffers are hospitality to your future self.

the unexpected dinner.

what we saw.
Travel lighter so you can move freer.
